title: Updates
optional: Optional. Downloads and installation start only after a click.
upToDate: The installed version is up to date.
installHelp: Verifies the download and files with SHA-256, backs up the previous application and saved tracks, then restarts. The Node runtime is unchanged.
dirty: Save your changes or close the editor first.
addonHelp: RaceHubOS remains responsible for installing this add-on. Download the matching package and use the available host installation procedure. This planner does not modify the RaceHubOS core.
systemHelp: This system installation is updated through the Debian package manager. Download the official package and check the release SHA256SUMS.
manualHelp: Direct installation is unavailable here. Download the matching release package and check its SHA256SUMS.

errors.generic: The update could not be completed.
errors.network: The update source is unreachable. The planner still works offline.
errors.rateLimit: GitHub is limiting requests. Please try again later.
errors.integrity: Checksums do not match. Nothing was installed.
errors.incompatible: The package or its runtime requirements are incompatible.
errors.backupFailed: The backup could not be created. Nothing was installed.
errors.installFailed: Installation failed. The previous application was restored.
errors.rollbackFailed: Restoration could not finish. The backup is preserved; follow the recovery instructions.
errors.startupFailed: The new version did not start. The previous application was restored.
errors.restartTimeout: Restart is taking longer than expected. Reopen the page and check the status.
errors.changed: The release changed. Please check for updates again.
errors.confirmationRequired: Start installation from the update panel.
errors.manualOnly: Only manual installation is available here.
errors.unsupportedInstallation: This installation cannot be updated directly.
errors.preference: The browser could not persist the startup preference.
errors.interrupted: The update was interrupted. The backup and recovery instructions are available.
errors.invalidBundle: Select Carrera-Track-Planner-update.json. Add-on or track plan JSON files are not application updates.
errors.alreadyCurrent: This version is already installed. Nothing was changed.
errors.activeSession: End the active or paused session first.
errors.localOnly: Open direct updates locally on the race computer via localhost.

fileHelp: Select a downloaded Carrera-Track-Planner-update.json. It is checked against the official release and checksums, then installed with backup and restart.
addonInstallHelp: Verifies the official add-on and checksums, backs up the planner and RaceHubOS database, and runs the local compatibility checks. The planner view then reloads.
